GuardEquivalence.Invariant: An accepted stop needs first width >= 6*pitch and second <= 2*pitch; an accepted start needs >= 7*pitch. First <= 2*second therefore cannot satisfy the unchanged fit. Positive scanline widths sum within the image dimension.

Separate assembly contexts use identical preloaded RGBA32 and options; loading and outcome evaluation are excluded.
